title: Rational equivariant modular cohomology law for type-one triples of regular-semisimple Hessenberg twin manifolds
author: Kiem, Young-Hoon; Lee, Donggun
work: Geometry of the twin manifolds of regular semisimple Hessenberg varieties and unicellular LLT polynomials

primary_locator.scope: type (1) triples only, including arbitrary-r Frobenius identity and the modular r=1 equivariant-cohomology isomorphisms

difficulty_reason: The author constructs a simultaneous projective-fibration and blowup roof, computes its cohomology, and proves the two symmetric-group actions coincide by an injective fixed-point restriction and an explicit coordinate-plane filtration. Only type-one triples are selected, whose full filtration proof is written out; the omitted type-two parallel argument is excluded.
